posts.trend: ₹16,500 rent, ₹12,000 iPhone EMI: Mumbai founder reveals her ₹52,000 monthly expenses
posts.context: Urban Indians are spending more on the tools that project wealth than on the actual shelter they live in.
posts.angle: Your monthly expenses are an index of different brands that own pieces of your time.
slides: Your bank statement is a conflict of interest.

Landlord's bank account — ₹16,500.

Apple's finance department — ₹12,000.

Zomato's platform fee account — ₹4,500.

Your savings account — ₹432.

You are working for three different corporations.

None of them is your own.
posts.caption: A diversified portfolio of payments. 💸
